newsitem.title: UK: Pearson says underlying H1 profit rise 5.8 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Pearson says underlying H1 profit rise 5.8 mln stg.

text.p: Pearson Plc's underlying profits from continuing operations rose 5.8 million stg in the first half of the year, finance director John Makinson said on Monday.
The headline figure for continuing operations almost doubled to 65.5 million stg from 33.5 million a year earlier.

However, Makinson said the comparison was flattered by the absence this year of restructuring costs and write-offs from the Mindscape consumer software unit -- which together totalled 37.7 million stg in the period a year ago.

Foreign exchange factors and higher Channel 5 losses did trim profits by 13.9 million stg in the first six months of 1997. Makinson also noted that the contribution from investment banking associate Lazards was down by over 10 million stg on the period a year ago.
Mindscape lost 15.1 million stg in the first half of the year but is expected to return to profit in the next six months.
